scripts.typecheck: corepack pnpm -r --filter "./packages/*" --workspace-concurrency=1 run build && corepack pnpm --filter @byoki/example typecheck
scripts.test: corepack pnpm build && corepack pnpm -r --filter "./packages/*" --filter @byoki/example run test && vitest run
scripts.build:site: corepack pnpm build && corepack pnpm --filter @byoki/example build
scripts.dev: corepack pnpm build && corepack pnpm --filter @byoki/example dev
scripts.publish:packages: corepack pnpm build && corepack pnpm -r --filter "./packages/*" publish --access public --no-git-checks
